summary.answer: The27 HUD helpers preserve exact waypoint/objective/model setup, client/actor/grenade/armblade loops, blood cache, focus routing, timers and wheel input/choice behavior. Waypoint setup is reached only in the recovered nonempty resolved-path arm; active/done widgets use exact state callbacks and removal order. Positive SetXFractionByModel starts a16-duration updater without closing an existing positive-path timer or clamping its ratio. Damage state uses a600-duration reset timer. Wheel length uses0.5/0.9 hysteresis; disabling can recover the previous wedge then pulses chosen true/false before _onChooseWedge. Right-stick close unlock and exact spray/callout notifications remain deferred/native requests, not game proof.
